sar.narrative: On December 29, 2016, an unauthorized online transaction of $131.30 for product C was executed on card C11923-K2 under a suspicious device profile. Customer C11923 disputed the charge, stating they never made the purchase. The transaction used a new device profile, SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | ? | chrome 66.0 for android | ?, which is shared across multiple cards and associated with prior confirmed fraud cases. This shared device profile indicates a coordinated fraud ring operating across multiple accounts. Because the cardholder confirmed they did not authorize the purchase and the activity ties into a wider device network, a suspicious activity report is required under policy R6. The fraud was carried out online to exploit card not present vulnerabilities without the cardholder's knowledge.

stop_reason: The cardholder's denial settles the verdict under R2 and the graph evidence has been collected; further steps would not change the actions.
